origin.description: Moves the two nearest codes when they disagree and sit in the window.
origin.details: Moves the two nearest codes when they disagree and sit in the window.
origin.example:
cat(set.seed(1)
  rows <- matrix(c(0,0, 0,1, 0.2,0.1, 5,5, 5,6, 5.2,4.8), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
  book <- list(x=matrix(c(0,0, 5,5), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE), cl=c(1L,2L))
  as.numeric(lvq2(rows, c(1L,1L,1L,2L,2L,2L), book, niter=6, alpha=0.2, win=0.3)$x), "\n")
